highlights: Rebranded to Anchor ('Rock-solid time for serious play') with a platform-agnostic core architecture ready for future iOS and desktop targets
Multimedia notification drawer controls with Play/Pause, Tempo -/+ buttons, and live BPM display
Per-count accent memory preserved across time signature changes
Always-visible audio output selection showing all available outputs (including single Speaker)
Configurable Play & Tap Tempo button trigger mode (On Tap/Press vs. On Release)
Full Google Play Store and plain AOSP compatibility with zero Google Play Services dependencies
